description:
TraefikService is the CRD implementation of a Traefik Service.
TraefikService object allows to:
- Apply weight to Services on load-balancing
- Mirror traffic on services
More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.6/reference/routing-configuration/kubernetes/crd/http/traefikservice/

config_fields.description: HighestRandomWeight defines the highest random weight service configuration.
Mirroring defines the Mirroring service configuration.
Weighted defines the Weighted Round Robin configuration.
